mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 20 trading days in at least 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 60 trading days in at least 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to a statistically significant positive return over the next 5 trading days in at least 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < 0% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 20 trading days in at least 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to a statistically significant positive return over the next 60 trading days in at least 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases do not lead to a statistically significant positive return over the next 20 trading days in at least 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a contraction in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY < 0% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 5 trading days in at least 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy with deflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with deflationary pressure
failure_condition: If the joint condition of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 20 trading days in at least 60% of the triggered instances.
